annotator: Codex visual inspection; one agent, no independent adjudication
protocol: Every distinct JPG in data/uploads was visually inspected before this evaluation run. Repeated byte-identical uploads count once. These are agent-created annotations, not externally validated ground truth. The annotator had previously worked on this pipeline and its unlabelled smoke benchmark: this is unblinded development evaluation, not a held-out accuracy claim.
scope: Visible printed text and field extraction only. No package-completeness, legal compliance, medical, allergen-safety, expiry-safety or barcode-registration verdict is annotated. Filenames and barcode databases must not supply unseen text. Front prices are visible rupee amounts; their annotation does not certify a legally complete MRP declaration.
coordinate_system: Approximate manually drawn axis-aligned boxes [left, top, right, bottom], original decoded image pixels. Bounds enclose readable target text, not precise glyph segmentation. No EXIF rotations were required by these ten originals.

matching_policy.structured: Exact equality of the specified structured value after Unicode NFKC, case and whitespace normalization, with source-box overlap. Numeric price amounts compare exactly as decimal numbers; no fuzzy matching. Brand and sub-brand are both acceptable only when explicitly transcribed as alternatives before the run. Generic-name targets are explicitly printed commodity tokens, not inferred product categories.
matching_policy.ocr: An exact case-insensitive printed target span in a spatially overlapping OCR box, either selected text or any retained processing candidate. Token boundaries prevent 20 matching 200; decimal/date punctuation is significant. Whitespace and case alone are ignored. This measures text recovery, not correct field assignment.
matching_policy.unknown: Unannotated target fields inherit unknown_default, optionally overridden below. They are excluded from the accuracy denominator. An output in an unknown region is reported without assigning correctness. Missing-side, occluded, illegible and absent-from-this-view never mean absent from the entire package.
